facts.label: reconcile
facts.scope: one read-only RR snapshot of the selected synthetic note pool; pre/post captures sequential; global consumer-failure rows include earlier stages in the owned DB

derived.scope: selected note set membership and per-user version hash; __complete is optional and not treated as a count proof

limitations: Final convergence is not steady-state proof; the common stage observer must separately record last-minute backlog/lag and the 60s recovery deadline.
